name: Bangalore
description: A place that became part of our story —  journeys from Kerala to Bangalore that creates new memories and experiences.

name: Thattekad - Mini Switzerland
description:
This was the first place we visited together after we confessed our love for each other. We reached Mini Switzerland around 6 in the morning, greeted by a cool, peaceful atmosphere with hardly anyone around to disturb us. It felt as though we had found a little corner of the world where we could simply be ourselves.

We wandered all around Mini Switzerland, taking in the surroundings and enjoying the quietness of the early morning. We made fun of each other, laughed over little things, and created memories that would become part of our story.

What made that morning special wasn't just the place itself, but the fact that we were experiencing it together for the first time as two people who had finally confessed what they felt for each other. Every little moment brought us closer, and every laugh added something to the bond we were beginning to build.

Looking back, that morning feels like the start of a beautiful new chapter in our lives. We had no idea how many memories, challenges, and moments of happiness lay ahead of us. All we had was each other, a quiet morning, and the beginning of a bond we hoped would last forever.
